display_name: Prudential Vietnam, term life insurance with a personal accident benefit: the 2-page summary notes and the full Rules and Terms with the payout-rate annex (V5_072020)

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md (as corrected by the lead on 2026-10-06: the PDF holds both the notes and the Rules and Terms)

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the raw text, and in short runs checked by tools/vnsrc.py to occur verbatim in it. Lines marked [page-read p.24] carry the grouping of annex section 3, read from the page image.

source.contents: src 1-97: the summary notes (2 pages); src 98-1103: the Rules and Terms, Parts I and II and the annex (22 pages)

scope: The whole document. The summary notes, items 1-4, in pru-notes.l4, labelled 'from the summary notes' and called by no rule of the Rules and Terms. The Rules and Terms: Articles 1-17 and the annex's four sections, every row as data. Inert (quoted, no test): 1.1, 2.1, 2.3, 10.7, 12.1(a), 12.1(c), 12.2(b), 13.1, 13.2(a), the headings. Reached and refused: Article 3 for a death not caused by an Accident. Inputs with no default: the sum insured, premiums, surrender value, debts, medical costs, Prudential's minimums and charges, the interest rate. Law 08/2022/QH15 is not encoded; it appears as LAW- forks. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F-01: Days are calendar days counted from the day after; 'within N days of X' ends on X+N; months by add months.
forks.F-02: The term ends on the earlier of the chosen anniversary and the first anniversary on or after the 70th birthday.
forks.F-04: Annex section 3: the leg-bone row is 30% and the arm-bone row 15%, from the page image.
forks.F-05: A 'one or more' fracture row is paid once per Accident; other rows once per bone.
forks.F-06: A burn takes the first matching annex row, the highest; rows are not summed.
forks.F-08: A 29 February birthday falls on 28 February in a common year.
forks.F-09: Temporary cover runs from application with first premium to the decision day inclusive; a direct or indirect cause excludes.
forks.F-10: In 5, 7 and 11.2 the deductions apply after taking the greater amount.
forks.F-11: 11.1(e): excluded unless prescribed by a Doctor and the influence caused the Accident.
forks.F-12: 11.1(g): strictly before the later of the effective and latest reinstatement dates.
forks.F-13: 11.2 has no 180-day limit, needs the contract in force, and is tested before 8.1's 180 days.
forks.F-15: 11.3 carves the case of one of several beneficiaries out of 11.1(f).
forks.F-16: 11.3: the whole benefit is shared among the other beneficiaries pro rata.
forks.F-17: 8.10: debts are deducted once from what is paid.
forks.F-20: 8.10: only injury benefits paid for the same Accident are deducted from the death benefit, not below 0.
forks.F-21: 10.8.2: the first limb that yields a recipient; heirs exist only after a death.
forks.F-22: Notes 'hoặc và 500 triệu đồng, tùy số nào nhỏ hơn' is the lesser.
forks.F-23: 8.6: the contract year of the Accident; in force on its date.
forks.F-24: 8.4, 8.5: age last birthday on the accident date; the cap compared with all payments in the term.
forks.F-25: 8.9: a term cut short by the age-70 limit has no stated rate (REFUSE).
forks.F-26: Article 6: 24 months from the later date with no cessation in between.
forks.F-27: Article 16: a lapse ends the contract the day after 24 months.
forks.F-28: The last day of the term is the anniversary itself.
forks.F-29: 8.2 tests 'in force' on the date of the injury; 8.3-8.6 on the accident date.
forks.F-30: 15.1: a contract with a surrender value does not lapse at the end of grace.
forks.F-31: 1.17(a): a mere weakening of the limbs is not paralysis.
forks.F-32: The dangerous-activity lists are open; whether an activity is dangerous is an input.
forks.LAW-01: 12.2(a) keeps the premium on rescission; Law Art 22(2) requires a refund. Not resolved.
forks.LAW-02: 10.6's 12 months have no force-majeure or knowledge extension; Law Art 30 has both. Not resolved.
forks.LAW-03: 10.6's 30 days and interest are consistent with Law Art 31.
forks.LAW-04: 15.1's automatic premium loan against Law Art 37(4). Not resolved.
forks.LAW-05: 11.2 pays nothing for an excluded injury; Law Art 40(3). Not resolved.
forks.LAW-06: 8.7 and Law Art 40(1)(a) on suicide: consistent.
forks.LAW-07: 12.1(f) requires Prudential's approval; Law Art 41(3) confirmation. Not resolved.
forks.LAW-08: 12.1(e) is silent on the insured's consent to assignment, which Law Art 28(1) requires.
forks.LAW-11: Law Art 39(2)(a): a minor insured needs a parent's or guardian's written consent; 1.2 is silent.
